capabilities: Render the vault graph in 3D with orbit, pan, zoom and inertia
Filter nodes by search, tags, attachments, existing files and orphans
Colour nodes by colour groups, folder, tag or link count
Freeze a node's connections and orbit around the highlight
Open notes, pin node positions and preview pages from the graph
extras: Search matches note names, paths and tags but not note content; the O(n²) force simulation is comfortable up to a couple of thousand notes. Works on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: Armillary is a drop-in companion to the core graph view: the same filters, groups, display and force controls
motivation: The README's 'Why another 3D graph' section explains the author wanted a dependency-free, WebGL-free 3D graph with full feature parity with the core graph.
problem: Obsidian's core graph view is limited to 2D, so users wanting a three-dimensional look at vault structure have no built-in option.
summary: 3D graph view that renders the vault graph on a 2D canvas with orbit, zoom, freeze, and the core graph's filters, groups and force controls.
